column1: # the link-plan facts plainglue.py derive cannot compute from the repository (plainglue.py facts writes them from
# a finished cmake/fullexe build at each glue refresh; derive reads them):
#   pick     <unit>  <recipe:name>   an engine twin (two units-gb.json entries, one unit) linked from the entry
#                                    that is not the default (the first recipe:name): the gate's pair counts chose it
#   va       <unit>  <hex va>        an engine or library unit with no progress/status.tsv row, placed at its gate
#                                    pairs' lowest exe VA (shared COMDATs that status.tsv credits to another unit)
#   closure  <unit>  <kind>  <obj>   an obj with no exe VA that the link pulls in for a symbol nothing else defines
#                                    (COFF symbol closure over the built objs), in link order
#   noinit   <unit>                  a unit that the exe's .CRT$XC table names but whose objs register no static
#                                    initializer of their own (initorder.py leaves it out of the ranking)
